newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares ease on profittaking ahead of tax.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares ease on profittaking ahead of tax.

text.p: Slovenian shares fell 1.47 percent on Monday as investors in shares of newly privatised firms rushed to cash in profits ahead of a new 25-percent tax on profits from securities that will be enforced from January.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 17.36 points to 1,167.3.
* Turnover jumped to 250.7 million tolars from 192.8 million.
* Overall nine shares fell, four rose and one remained unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek's "A" issue was the most actively traded, falling 0.76 percent to 19,690 tolars on volume of 7,946 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
